fields.description: Number of characters taken from the affiliate's full name when auto-generating a referral code, up to 8 (the referral_code field's max length). Shorter names are right-padded with 0. Leave 0/blank for the full 8.
fields.label: Referral Code Name Length

fields.description: Minimum available balance before an affiliate can request a payout. Applied per payout currency: each currency's own balance must reach this threshold, since a payout can only ever combine commissions of a single currency.
fields.label: Minimum Cashout

fields.description: Payout mode pre-selected for newly registered affiliates. Existing affiliates keep whatever they chose themselves in their portal settings.
fields.label: Default Payout Mode

fields.description: Day of the month (1-28) on which the monthly payout batch is generated for affiliates whose payout mode is Monthly. Leave 0/blank to disable monthly payouts entirely. A batch that couldn't run on the day itself (e.g. downtime) is generated automatically on the first day the scheduler runs afterwards - each period only ever runs once.
fields.label: Monthly Payout Day

fields.description: Date the monthly payout batch last ran. Auto-tracked by the scheduler - do not edit. Used to make the monthly batch idempotent: each scheduled period only ever generates one batch, even across restarts or catch-up days.
fields.label: Last Monthly Batch Run

fields.description: Gross = commission on the pre-discount total (sum of positive line items, before referral/voucher discounts). Nett = ERPNext's native total_commission field, which requires the linked travel items to have "Grant Commission" enabled.
fields.label: Commission Base

fields.description: If checked, Sales Orders for addons (Travel Addon / Travel Insurance) created from a booking also carry the booking's Sales Partner, so the affiliate earns commission on addon sales too. When unchecked, only the primary package Sales Order is attributed.
fields.label: Commission on Addons

fields.description: When a commission already Paid is later voided (Sales Order/Invoice cancelled, returned, or credit-noted), automatically create a reversing commission (negative amount) to claw back the payout from the affiliate's balance. If unchecked, clawback is left entirely to manual admin handling.
fields.label: Auto Clawback on Refund/Cancel

fields.description: A Sales Order reaching this status marks the linked commission as "Approved" (eligible for the affiliate to cash out) - but only while no Sales Invoice exists yet. Once a Sales Invoice is linked, the SI rule below takes over instead.
fields.label: Approve Commission When Sales Order Status Is
fields.options:
Draft
On Hold
To Deliver and Bill
To Bill
To Deliver
Completed

fields.description: A Sales Invoice reaching this status marks the linked commission as "Approved" (eligible for the affiliate to cash out) - this takes priority over the Sales Order rule above once an invoice exists.
fields.label: Approve Commission When Sales Invoice Status Is
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
Unpaid
Partly Paid
Overdue
Unpaid and Discounted
Overdue and Discounted
Paid

fields.description: AI service used for ID document OCR (extracting name, IC number, birthdate, gender, address from the uploaded ID) and for verifying the affiliate's entered details against that document. Both providers use the same OpenAI-compatible chat API - only the base URL, model and key differ.
fields.label: AI Integration (ID OCR & Verification)

fields.description: Secret API key for the selected provider (platform.openai.com for OpenAI, z.ai / open.bigmodel.cn for GLM). Stored as a password - it is never sent back to the browser.
fields.label: AI API Key

fields.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint root. Leave blank for the provider default (OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, GLM: https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4). Only change this for a proxy or a different compatible provider.
fields.label: AI Base URL

fields.description: Vision-capable chat model. Leave blank for the provider default (OpenAI: gpt-4o-mini, GLM: glm-4v-flash). GLM alternatives: glm-4.5v, glm-4v-plus.
fields.label: AI Model

fields.description: When the affiliate uploads their ID document in the portal wizard, run AI OCR over it and show the detected details (full name, national ID, birthdate, gender, address) so they can apply them to their profile with one click.
fields.label: Extract ID Data with AI (OCR)

fields.description: When the affiliate submits wizard step 2, compare the details they filled in against the uploaded ID document with AI. The verdict (Match / Mismatch and why) is stored on the Affiliate Profile for the approving admin to review. A mismatch warns the affiliate but never blocks the submission - the admin makes the final call.
fields.label: Verify Filled Details with AI
